items.title: Pacers officially waived two-way guard Ethan Thompson, allowing for him to pursue an opportunity overseas.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Pacers officially waived two-way guard Ethan Thompson, allowing for him to pursue an opportunity overseas.

That opens up one of their three two-ways contracts, and rookie guard Braden Smith remains unsigned.

items.title: Pacers have waived Ethan Thompson from his two-way contract, league sources confirm.
items.author: Tony East
items.body_excerpt: Pacers have waived Ethan Thompson from his two-way contract, league sources confirm.

items.title: The Indiana Pacers are waiving two-way guard Ethan Thompson, league sources told HoopsHype. Thompson averaged 7.0 points in 20.4 minutes per game during 32 games played for Indiana last season. Partizan has showed significant interest in signing Thompson to join the EuroLeague.
